welcome.title: Welcome to ArbiScanner
welcome.description: ArbiScanner monitors price differences across multiple exchanges in real time, helping you spot profitable spread trading opportunities — including funding, spot, and futures spreads.

spreadTypes.title: Three Spread Types
spreadTypes.description:
Futures — price gap between futures contracts on two exchanges.
Funding — perpetual funding rate arbitrage between longs and shorts.
Spot — price difference for the same asset on two spot markets.

smartAlerts.title: Smart Alerts
smartAlerts.description: Set your minimum spread threshold in Account Settings. You will get notified instantly — via dashboard and Telegram — whenever a spread exceeds your target.

getStarted.title: Get Started
getStarted.description: Register an account, subscribe to a plan, then configure your preferences in Account Settings: choose your exchanges, set your spread size threshold, and connect Telegram for instant alerts.

hero.title: Welcome to ArbiScanner
hero.subtitle: The ultimate web app to trade different types of spreads including <highlight>funding</highlight>, <highlight>spot</highlight>, and <highlight>futures spreads</highlight>.

personalize.title: Personalize Experience
personalize.description: Tailor your dashboard by selecting only the exchanges you like and trust. Focus on what matters to you.

riskManagement.title: Risk Management
riskManagement.description: Define your custom position size to match your portfolio and risk tolerance automatically.

smartAlerts.title: Smart Alerts
smartAlerts.description: Set your minimum spread thresholds to get notified instantly when profitable opportunities arise.

liveDemo.title: See It In Action
liveDemo.description: This is what a real spread looks like on ArbiScanner — updating in real time with a live chart and order book depth.
